author: 5thteen
body:
Hey guys. I'm new to team tournaments, so this is the first time potentially joining a team.

Firstly le stats!! (9/6/15 may change.)

Kills - 9,931
Deaths - 3,171
K/D - 3.13
K/D PvP - 3.55
Ping - 113

Why choose me?

Bow is my specialty
Good at pvp,
Generally patient
Organised
Can shift stair and shift bridge fast
I CAN PLAY ANYWHERE!!!! - Attack, Defense, Mid, the lot.
Total of 10 days on the server ( a lot of experience)


You can contact me through Skype, twitter or on here. I should be available form most times after the 18th June, when all my exams are done :)

Thanks for reading. 

                                      5th
                        
P.S I am from the U.K, just to let you know

replies.body:
Hello, the Prime Platoon is highly interested in your skills and ability to play. If you're still looking for a team, please post an application with the same information above and note that you were asked to join the team in the application. If you do so, you will be accepted automatically. We hope you join us with your great talent. Have a great day!

-The Prime Platoon
